weather.note: observed lags only - these are 16 of the 35 model inputs, summarised per station. The 7-day bars cover the days before the scoring date, i.e. exactly the period the lags are computed from. No forecast is used: the model was trained on weather that has already happened.

forecast.note: Outlook from Open-Meteo. NOT an input to the model - the weather features are backward lags. Use it as context next to the ranking, never as a cause of a probability.

explain.method: permutation-sampled Shapley values; baseline = median feature vector of the 430 scored trip points; 24 random orderings per trip point
explain.note: Contributions are in probability points and sum to (this trip point's risk - the baseline risk). They explain the model's output, not causality: a high positive value for 'days since last fault' means that feature pushed this trip point up relative to a median trip point, not that it caused the fault.
